description: This PHP file defines the AdminSphereEditForm class, which extends AbstractFormProcessor. It provides functionality to create and process a form for editing 'Sphere' entities in an admin interface, including fields for name, icon, landing match, and associated SDGs. The class also handles saving form data to the model, with validation and error handling.

classes.name: AdminSphereEditForm
classes.description: Form processor class for editing 'Sphere' entities in the admin panel, managing form creation, validation, and saving of data related to spheres.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for a given form field, currently enforces that the field is not blank.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the form with fields for name, icon, landing match checkbox, and SDGs, setting appropriate options and populating choices.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates data, updates the model with the form data, manages icon uploads/removals, saves the model, and updates associated SDGs.
